heroSub: 5 hand-picked hotels near Krabi Airport that we've already reviewed in depth — a hotel with a pool plus a kids' pool, a small clean and quiet boutique, a new-build transit stay, a budget hotel with an industrial design, and a resort set among palm groves with its own golf driving range. Every one is just 5–10 min by car from the airport (KBV), with prices starting around ฿600–900/night.
introH2: ✈️ What kinds of hotels are near Krabi Airport, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Krabi is a city many people use as their gateway to the Andaman Sea — you fly in, then continue by car or boat out to Koh Lanta, Koh Phi Phi, Ao Nang, or Railay, and that's exactly why "a hotel near the airport" becomes a real question for Krabi travelers. Some people land late at night and don't want a long drive in the dark, some have a pre-dawn flight and have to be up before sunrise, and some just want one night's rest before catching a boat to the islands the next morning. Hotels near Krabi Airport don't all look alike — some are hotels with a pool to cool off after the journey, some are small quiet boutiques that focus on cleanliness, some are new buildings right next to a 7-Eleven and a mall, and some are resorts in the palm groves with their own golf driving range. This article rounds up 5 hotels near Krabi Airport that we've already reviewed in depth, across both the Krabi Noi and Nuea Khlong areas — every one just 5–10 min by car from the airport. It comes from reading guests' real reviews, gives you both the upsides and the honest caveats, compares prices across 3 sites, and includes direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Krabi has no metro — the main way to get around is renting a car or motorbike, or calling a Grab/taxi. Krabi International Airport (KBV) sits on Phetkasem Road, about 15 km from the city center and around 25–30 km from Ao Nang beach. The stays in this article cluster in two sub-districts near the airport: Krabi Noi — on the Phetkasem Road stretch between the airport and the city, close to a 7-Eleven and a Lotus's, about 10–15 min into town. Nuea Khlong — south of the airport, quiet and surrounded by greenery, closest to the airport at around 3–4 km, but with few restaurants nearby. Both areas stand out for being close to the airport rather than close to the sea, so they work well as a base for the first or last night of a trip that's tight against a flight, with a beachfront stay in the middle of the trip.

entries.type: 4-Star Hotel Near the Airport · With a Pool
entries.name: Nap Krabi Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Krabi Noi · Phetkasem Road · 5–10 min from airport
entries.addr: 575 Moo 11, Phetkasem Road, Krabi Noi, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: If we're starting with the most "advantaged" airport-area hotel in this group, we'll begin with Nap Krabi Hotel, because it does something most hotels near the airport can't — it has an outdoor pool, a kids' pool, and a gym all in one place. It's a 4-star hotel on Phetkasem Road in the Krabi Noi sub-district, just around 3–6 km from Krabi Airport (KBV), or 5–10 min by car. It's been open since 2017, holds the SHA Extra Plus standard, and has 80 rooms, every one with a private balcony. Among these 5 stays, Nap Krabi has the most reviews at around 391, with an overall score of about 7.8, which fits its role. From the real reviews, the points guests agree on are that rooms are clean and look new, staff are friendly and helpful (the staff score on Booking.com is high at around 8.1), and the Wi-Fi is fast and stable enough to score near-perfect. Families traveling with kids especially like the kids' pool, while those landing late or leaving pre-dawn get a 24-hour front desk to handle check-in. There are honest caveats from the reviews to prepare for too: restaurants around the hotel are hard to find — there's basically only a 7-Eleven, so you have to drive into town; soundproofing between rooms isn't great and you can hear the neighbors; some bathrooms don't get very hot or feel damp; the pool is fairly small and crowded at times; and there's a review that once hit a case of the airport shuttle not arriving on schedule, nearly missing a flight, so it's worth re-confirming the car the night before you travel. In short, if you want a hotel near the airport that still has a pool to cool off in and a gym to use, at a light starting price, Nap Krabi is a well-rounded choice for the first or last night of a trip that's tight against a flight.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you book the airport shuttle, re-confirm with the front desk the night before you travel and have a ride-hailing app ready as backup. And if you arrive late and hungry, buy food beforehand because the hotel's outlet closes early and there's only a 7-Eleven nearby.

entries.type: Small Boutique Hotel · Near the Airport
entries.name: Palmari Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.8 · 77 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.4/5, #1 in Nuea Khlong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nuea Khlong · Phetkasem Road · ~4 km from airport
entries.addr: 285 Moo 2, Phet Kasem Road, Nuea Khlong, Krabi
entries.storyHtml: If Nap Krabi stands out for its facilities, Palmari Boutique Hotel plays a different game: "small, clean, quiet, and friendly." It's a tiny boutique hotel of just 9 rooms, run like a family hotel, at 285 Moo 2, Phetkasem Road, Nuea Khlong district, just around 4 km from Krabi International Airport (KBV), or 5–10 min by car. Among this group, Palmari is the one that climbed to #1 on TripAdvisor out of 5 specialty lodging properties in Nuea Khlong, with a score of 8.8 from 77 reviews on Trip.com and 4.4 out of 5 on TripAdvisor. What the real reviews praise most consistently is that the rooms are "spotlessly clean, quiet, and bright" — many say the rooms look freshly renovated, with unexpected touches for this price like a rain shower, a minibar, and free drinking water. Another charm is the staff and owner, whom reviews describe as friendly and helpful beyond the call of duty — there are accounts of them personally walking guests over to a nearby restaurant, and in low season sometimes arranging a free shuttle. There's an in-house restaurant called Coffepalm, which helps a lot in an area with few places around. Honest caveats: the Nuea Khlong location is far from the main attractions, with Ao Nang beach and Railay around 28–30 km away; there's no pool and no elevator; rooms facing Phetkasem Road get traffic noise even at night; Wi-Fi is weak in some rooms; and there's a review noting a shower glass panel to be careful with. In short, if you're after a clean, quiet, light-priced place to sleep before a flight or before catching a boat to Koh Lanta, and you don't mind being in a quiet area, Palmari does that job so well it's kept guests coming back.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Use the hotel's airport shuttle (around 200 baht), because in the Nuea Khlong area hailing a ride yourself is harder than in town. And if you're a light sleeper, ask for an interior room that doesn't face Phetkasem Road — it's much quieter.

entries.type: 2-Star Stay Near the Airport · New Building
entries.name: Wanarom Residence Hotel
entries.badge: 🧼 Cleanest in the group · highest score
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Krabi Noi · Phetkasem Road · 8 min from airport
entries.addr: 351 Moo 12 Petchkasem Road, Krabi Noi, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Among these 5 stays, if you measure by overall score, Wanarom Residence Hotel is the one that posts the highest at 8.9 from 144 reviews on Trip.com, and 4.9 out of 5 on TripAdvisor. It's a small 2-star stay on Phetkasem Road in the Krabi Noi area, open since 2018, so it still counts as a new building compared to many budget stays in Krabi, with around 53 rooms, most with a small balcony looking onto the garden or a city angle. What pushed it to the front is its cleanliness score as high as 9.3, which is very high for a stay at this level — many reviews stress the same point, that rooms are clean and bigger than expected for this price, beds dressed in clean white linen, often with towels folded into a welcoming swan. The location is an advantage too: just around 5.5 km from Krabi Airport (KBV), or 8 min by car, next to a 7-Eleven and close to a Lotus's, so basic food and supplies are easy to get even though it's not downtown. Staff earn praise for their kindness, especially helping call a car to the airport pre-dawn, and there's a review saying they came back to stay a second time. Honest caveats: the location means you need a car to go anywhere because there's no motorbike rental nearby and no restaurants within walking distance; the bed is fairly firm for some; some amenities are provided sparingly; the fridge doesn't work well in some rooms; and the breakfast and airport-shuttle terms are stated inconsistently across platforms, so check before booking. In short, if you value a clean room and being close to the airport more than a resort atmosphere, Wanarom is a transit-night choice so good value it's hard to find a rival at this price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Stock up on drinking water and snacks from the 7-Eleven right next door for a late-night or pre-dawn meal before your flight. And if you want a soft mattress, brace yourself for the bed that many reviews call fairly firm, or ask for an extra topper at check-in.

entries.name: Srisuksant Urban
entries.badge: 🏙️ Industrial design · closest to the airport
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nuea Khlong · Phetkasem Road · ~3 km from airport
entries.addr: 98 Moo 2 Phetkasem Road, Nuea Khlong, Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Srisuksant Urban is the stay closest to Krabi Airport in this group — just around 3 km from Krabi International Airport (KBV), or 5–10 min by car. It's a small 3-star budget hotel with an industrial design, a 3-story building with just 18 rooms, at 98 Moo 2, Phetkasem Road, Nuea Khlong sub-district, scoring 8.4 from 35 reviews on Traveloka and 4.0 out of 5 on TripAdvisor. What sets it apart from the typical budget stay is its industrial-style design that plays with bare concrete walls, a gray-black palette, and modern furniture, making the rooms look more contemporary than the price suggests — many foreign reviewers use the words "spacious and modern." The most-praised point is cleanliness, which several platforms score especially high (Traveloka gives around 8.8), and sleep quality, which TripAdvisor rates around 4.7 out of 5 because it's quiet and far enough from the main road; the comfortable bed is mentioned again and again. The 24-hour front desk and the pre-dawn airport shuttle are points that impress early flyers. Honest caveats: there's no pool, it's not right by the beach or the city, there aren't many restaurants around the hotel so you need to prepare food or drive out to find some, the city is around 15 km away and Ao Nang around 25–30 min by car, some voices say staff service is inconsistent at times, and the number of online reviews still isn't large, so read the latest reviews alongside this. In short, if you have an early-morning flight, or land late and want to sleep comfortably in a clean room with a sharp design, closest to the airport at a light price, Srisuksant Urban is the most on-point choice.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Tell the front desk in advance to arrange a car to the airport (around 250 baht during the day and around 350 baht late at night to pre-dawn), which suits early-morning flights perfectly. And check on breakfast when you book, because some room rates add around 150 baht per person.

Very clean rooms that look new, industrial design more modern than the price
Comfortable bed, quiet, good sleep quality (from reviews)
24-hour front desk · free parking · has an airport shuttle

entries.type: Budget Resort · With Its Own Golf Driving Range
entries.name: Palm Driving Range & Resort
entries.badge: ⛳ Has its own golf driving range
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Krabi Noi · palm groves · ~10 min from airport
entries.storyHtml: We close with the stay that has a different character from everywhere else in the group — Palm Driving Range & Resort is a small family-run resort with around 8 rooms, set in the middle of palm groves in the Krabi Noi area, and its one-of-a-kind selling point is that it has a private golf driving range in the middle of the resort that every room faces — you can step off your balcony and go hit balls. The location is just around 4 km from Krabi Airport (KBV), or 10 min by car, and into the city in a similar time, with real-review scores of 4.1 out of 5 on TripAdvisor from 33 reviews and 3.9 out of 5 on Google from 38 reviews. What reviews agree on praising is that rooms are bigger than expected for this price — many use the words "very big room" — clean, with good sleep quality, and Wi-Fi faster than expected for a small resort outside town. The value category scores especially high at around 4.8 on TripAdvisor, and the owner and staff are family-friendly in a way that feels like staying at a relative's house. As for the driving range, the fee is very cheap at around 30 baht a basket, with club rental around 100 baht — an activity you won't find at the typical stay. Honest caveats: the location category scores lower than the others because it's outside the community area, there are no restaurants to walk to around it, calling a Grab isn't always convenient so you should have a car or motorbike, there's no pool, some reviews found a musty smell and insects in certain rooms at certain times, the hot water temperature is inconsistent, and being a small resort it may not have a 24-hour front desk. In short, if you want to sleep near the airport on a budget, or you're a golfer who wants to practice driving in a relaxed setting and have your own transport, Palm Driving Range & Resort is a choice that fits that need at a price with few rivals.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arrange the airport shuttle time in advance and confirm the price clearly (some reviews note around 100 baht per person), because there have been reports of the car arriving late. And bring snacks from the city or the airport beforehand, because the resort's outlet is open around 07:00–20:00 and there are no shops to walk to nearby.

faqTitle: FAQ — Questions travelers often ask about hotels near Krabi Airport

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best hotel near Krabi Airport?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style. If you want a pool and a gym, Nap Krabi Hotel is a 4-star hotel with a pool and a kids' pool. If you measure by score and cleanliness, Wanarom Residence Hotel scores 8.9, the highest in the article, with cleanliness 9.3. If you want a small quiet boutique, Palmari Boutique Hotel is TripAdvisor #1 in Nuea Khlong. If you want to be closest to the airport and fly early, Srisuksant Urban is around 3 km away. And if you're a golfer, Palm Driving Range & Resort has its own driving range.

faq.q: ❓ How much do hotels near Krabi Airport cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start around ฿600–900 per night. The easiest to reach are Nap Krabi from ฿600 and Palmari from ฿750 · Palm Driving Range from ฿800 · Wanarom from ฿850 · and Srisuksant Urban from ฿900. Family rooms or suites can climb to around ฿1,200–1,800, and during high season prices may be higher than usual. All prices are starting estimates from the standard rooms.

faq.q: ❓ How far are hotels near Krabi Airport from the airport, and how do you get around?
faq.a: All 5 are just 5–10 min by car from Krabi Airport (KBV). The closest is Srisuksant Urban at around 3 km, and Palmari / Palm Driving Range at around 4 km · Wanarom at around 5.5 km (8 min) and Nap Krabi at around 3–6 km. Krabi has no metro — use a rental car, motorbike, or Grab/taxi. Many stays have an airport shuttle service (for a fee), which you should book and confirm in advance.

faq.q: ❓ Which hotel near Krabi Airport has a pool?
faq.a: In this article the one with a clear pool is Nap Krabi Hotel, with an outdoor pool plus a kids' pool and a gym, which is hard to find among hotels near the airport. Palmari has a jacuzzi hot tub instead of a pool. Wanarom, Srisuksant Urban, and Palm Driving Range have no pool, because they focus on the role of a clean budget transit stay. If you want to soak in a pool all day, consider a resort on the Ao Nang side or on the islands instead.

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best if you want a hotel near Krabi Airport?
faq.a: Krabi Noi is on Phetkasem Road between the airport and the city, close to a 7-Eleven and a Lotus's, around 10–15 min into town (Nap Krabi, Wanarom, Palm Driving Range). Nuea Khlong is south of the airport, closest to the airport and quiet, surrounded by greenery, but with few restaurants nearby (Palmari, Srisuksant Urban). Both areas stand out for being close to the airport rather than close to the sea.

faq.q: ❓ How many nights should you stay near Krabi Airport, and how do you plan the trip?
faq.a: A strategy many people use and find worthwhile is to stay near the airport the first night when you land late, or the last night before an early flight, then stay beachfront on the Ao Nang side or on the islands in the middle of the trip — you get both the convenience of being near the airport and the beach atmosphere, without spending an expensive beachfront night sleeping while waiting for a flight. Many of these stays are small (8–80 rooms) and fill up fast during high season (Nov–Apr), so book ahead, and every platform offers Free Cancellation, so we recommend locking in that kind of rate first, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com to get the best price.
